why: A January 2025 arXiv paper (Appleby, Flammia, Kopp) gives a constructive approach to Zauner's conjecture reducing it to the Stark conjectures plus a new convolution identity, described as a serious conditional proof with a putatively complete list of SICs with Weyl-Heisenberg symmetry for all d>3; separately a January 2026 preprint claims a full unconditional proof for all finite dimensions, though expert review reportedly found a flaw (circular induction, false vertex identification).

found.title: A Constructive Approach to Zauner's Conjecture via the Stark Conjectures
found.note: Preprint constructing SICs in all dimensions d>3 conditional on Stark conjectures and a new Twisted Convolution Conjecture; not read.

found.title: SIC-POVM and Zauner's conjecture (Stefan Joka)
found.note: Preprint claiming an unconditional proof that SIC-POVMs exist in every finite dimension; secondary sources report expert review found the argument flawed (circular induction). Not read.
